description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
